highlights.title: Thousands take to Tel Aviv's streets for protests against Netanyahu
highlights.summary: Thousands marched against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government in Tel Aviv on Saturday – just three days before Israel's general election – demanding accountability for the failure to prevent a Hamas-led attack on October 7, 2023, that led to the war in Gaza.

highlights.title: France Protest Updates: Hundreds of Thousands March Amid Heavy Security
highlights.summary: The marches were largely peaceful until evening, when clashes popped up and the police used tear gas and water cannons to disperse some protesters in Marseille and Paris.
